digest.component_or_area: plan-review coaching moves and overlay criteria
propositions: When a plan's source-code reference inventory is hand-enumerated or incompletely enumerated, a corrective coaching move should direct the agent to re-derive references using Serena's symbol tools and string-literal sweep

Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven (load_move_registry reads .rebar/code_review_moves.json), but project.* criteria can never fire in code-review's closed applies_when vocabulary, so the criterion must route to plan_review only

A new project.symbol-reference-completeness criterion with advisory posture (no blocking_enabled key) and matching coaching move must be added to plan-review overlay files following the project.portability pattern

The criterion detects incomplete or hand-enumerated inventories and its move instructs re-derivation via find_referencing_symbols plus string-literal grepping (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) that LSP cannot resolve

Detection is demonstrated live across multiple real rebar review-plan runs at validity 1.0, naming omitted files including string-literal sites; coaching move applicability is proven deterministically in tests, though LLM selection determines whether it appears in output
